facts: Shelf walls (basalt shelf stacks) wrap the left, right and back of the 12 x 10 m room.
The centre object (meditative ritual basin) is the first stop, 4.2 m in from the door.
The route circles it first, then follows the shelves.
The counter (minimal payment counter) sits at the back, off the loop.
anchors: a few steps in, facing the centre object; you look at the meditative ritual basin (basin)
beside the left shelf wall; you look at the basalt shelf stacks (shelf_wall)
at the back of the loop, looking up at the dome; you look at the quiet study zone (zone)

args.title: The Basalt Library
args.subtitle: An immersive apothecary experience inspired by silence and stone.
args.line: A library of scents carved from the volcanic heart of Jeju.
args.synopsis: You step into a space where the heavy, porous walls of black basalt evoke the scent of ancient paper and volcanic earth. At the center of this quiet chamber, you pause at the meditative ritual basin, where water and fragrance cleanse the senses. You then circle the room, exploring the shelves that house bottles like volumes in a library, before reaching the back counter. Here, amidst the lingering scent of damp stone, you conclude your journey.
args.quote: Where the story ends, the ritual begins.
why: The surrounding black basalt shelves create an atmosphere of scholarly seclusion and tactile permanence.
The central basin serves as a physical and sensory anchor, compelling you to pause and participate in a cleansing rite.
The circular flow allows you to drift through the 'stacks' as if browsing a collection of literature.
The placement of the payment counter ensures that the final interaction remains separate from the tranquil browsing experience.
